answer: Sybil resistance links correlated equivocation across k bonded identities: pairwise evidence triggers penalties proportional to k(k−1)/2, or O(k²), rather than treating each signer independently. Upon detection, a swarm-level exponential multiplier increases capital loss across its escrows, making identity splitting costly. “Ivory,” “vine,” and “jetty” may label identities, but do not hide their correlated behavior.
